mainline: Natural-language proposed cost structure -> historical behavior inverse fitting -> fixed-decision risk auditing

comparisonArms.purpose: Candidate features/constraints from the same natural-language task, with no behavioral repair
Same initial proposal with historical parameter fitting
Same proposal and fitted candidate, adding declared-noise risk sensitivity
Potential separate comparison in tasks that actually contain rejected-solution/expert-correction pairs
comparisonArms.restriction: Do not label a generic prompt as an exact TACIT reproduction. Its richer supervision must be matched or evaluated separately.

requiredBeforeExecution: Freeze model versions, full prompts, decoding settings, task split and per-task call/token budgets before collecting results
Use fresh held-out language tasks, separate structure generation from truth/answer access
Record every original response, parse failure, infeasible proposal, timeout and repair
Evaluate model structure/feasibility equivalence separately from objective-value agreement
Record the evidence for the declared behavior-noise cap; never infer guaranteed coverage solely from training fit
Hold candidate decision and numeric assumptions fixed when comparing certificate mechanisms
Include decision regret, bad releases, abstention rate, resource cost and human-supervision availability
Do not mix manually supplied numeric features with genuine model-discovered features
notEstablished: No real-language accuracy or generalization has been measured
No external benchmark score has been produced
No paper method has been reproduced merely by citing it
